description: Non-exhaustive open-web searches found no supported October protest candidate beyond false-positive leads; search coverage used French/English and general, weekly, labor/mining, political/transition and regional-city dimensions. required_followup: The feasible broad, date-window, regional, sectoral and political open-web steps recorded in the dossier were performed; independent review may request additional bounded discovery, but no further specific event-led search was identified. This is not a zero-protest claim.

description: No LexisNexis-equivalent archive, systematic broadcast corpus, or exhaustive local-language news index was available. The historical source/access ledgers and publisher alias/origin mappings are absent; a no-match cannot establish clean historical access scope.

description: Searches returned stale and cross-border labor/protest results, including an announced Fekola strike in Mali, and weather-caused road traffic disruption in Burkina. These were filtered without treating search snippets as event evidence.
